title: Harness: integration, ADRs, and live PR QA
description: Linear: MIGHT-500. Integrate the harness extension, write ADRs, and run Droid Control live PR verification.
acceptance_criteria: Package manifest loads harness as a separate extension; existing UI/compactor work preserved; Node 22/24 test, typecheck, visual, focused integration, secret scan, and diff checks pass; Droid Control verifies all six capabilities live; Beads and Linear children updated.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Harness glue committed on feat/harness-omp-capabilities; focused harness tests + typecheck + git diff --check all green under Node 22.

title: Harness: OpenAI compaction for Codex sessions
description: Linear: MIGHT-495. Provider-gated custom session compaction for OpenAI Codex. Initial production path uses a dedicated OpenAI compactor role via modelRegistry.complete with native fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Gates on configured Codex/OpenAI policy and opt-in settings; uses full session_before_compact preparation; any failure returns undefined so Pi native compaction runs; no token/header/body logging; unit tests cover success, bypass, abort, fallback.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure Codex-compact core landed and harness glue now installs the gated session_before_compact hook with native fallback.

title: Harness: core agent and subagent substrate
description: Linear: MIGHT-499. Implement only the core agent/subagent substrate: profiles, discovery, bounded execution, cancellation, concurrency ceiling, streaming updates, and structured result envelopes. Exclude OMP delegation policy.
acceptance_criteria: subagent tool plus /agents list|run; isolated Pi SDK sessions; project-local profiles require trust confirmation; bounded concurrency; no nested fan-out unless profile enables it; unit, cancellation, cap, and Droid Control pass.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure agent substrate landed and harness glue now registers the bounded subagent tool plus /agents list|run.

title: Acidbath: integrate OMP-inspired harness capabilities
description: Umbrella for OMP-inspired Acidbath harness work. Linear: MIGHT-493. Separate non-visual harness extension owns handoff, roles, agent core, magic words, recap, and Codex compaction. Acidbath keeps UI; existing bash-result compactor stays independent.
acceptance_criteria: All six capabilities ship in a separate harness extension; Acidbath UI ownership unchanged; tests, typecheck, visual, and Droid Control live PR verification pass; no credential logging.

title: Harness: persistent session recap
description: Linear: MIGHT-494. Add /recap [focus] as a session-persistent, non-context custom entry generated through the recap model role.
acceptance_criteria: Recap survives resume/branch as a custom session entry not sent to the LLM by default; compacted history handled; empty/error/abort states do not append partial recaps; pure tests and Droid Control persistence pass.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure recap core landed and harness glue now appends acidbath-recap custom entries with an entry renderer.

title: Harness: exact-prose magic words
description: Linear: MIGHT-498. Add OMP-inspired magic words through a single registry and Pi input-transform pipeline. Match enabled words as standalone lowercase prose only.
acceptance_criteria: Registry is the single source; global and per-keyword switches work; table tests cover positive and blocked contexts; no mutation of the raw user-visible prompt; live TUI proves one match and one blocked false positive.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure magic.ts + tests landed (1061 pass). Glue /magic command, input transform, and Droid Control still remaining.

title: Harness: explicit model roles and fallback routing
description: Linear: MIGHT-496. Add a validated role registry and /role command for explicit user-selected routing. Support OMP-inspired aliases, thinking-level suffixes, role references, scoped-model preference, and ordered fallback.
acceptance_criteria: Deterministic parser/resolver tests cover exact, inherited, cyclic, unavailable, and fallback paths; no silent permission change; role clear restores prior state; live Droid Control verifies switch and fallback.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure roles.ts + tests landed (82 pass). Glue /role command and Droid Control still remaining.

title: Harness: structured cross-session handoff
description: Linear: MIGHT-497. Implement /handoff [goal] in the harness extension. Build a bounded structured handoff, generate with an explicit model role, allow TUI review/edit, then create a child session and prefill the replacement editor. Never auto-submit.
acceptance_criteria: Handles compacted and uncompacted branches; cancellation leaves current session unchanged; replacement context used after newSession; pure tests and Droid Control pass.

comments.author: Ameno Osman
comments.text: Pure handoff core landed and harness glue now wires /handoff via current-model generation + child-session prefill.
